note: UNAUTHORIZED ABSENCE ESCALATION. A DIFFERENT QUESTION FROM config/absence.json's morning-after sweep: that one tells somebody about ONE day; this one watches for an unexplained absence turning into a RUN and escalates as it crosses each day the tenant names below. Every day-count and every designation list is the tenant's own choice, versioned in module_customisations under the key below — nothing here is a number picked in code. Ships OFF, for the same reason config/absence.json does: turning this on for a tenant mid-way through a punch-import backlog would escalate people who were at their desk the whole time.
hierarchy_note: Who the escalation reaches UP THE EMPLOYEE'S OWN REPORTING CHAIN — their manager, their manager's manager, and so on, unconditionally. Every chain member is told; there is no designation filter to configure here.
always_cc_designations_note: Who is copied on EVERY escalation for every employee, regardless of the reporting chain — preferring a holder in the absent employee's own company, reaching tenant-wide only when this company has none. Shipped with the four designations SmartPRS 2 customers named; a tenant that has not yet created a designation by one of these exact names simply has nobody matched under it, not an error.
what_a_run_means: A day is ABSENT by config/attendance-rules.json's own published rules — the same verdict the muster and the payslip use. A weekly off or a holiday inside a run neither counts toward it nor breaks it; a real punch or an approved leave ends it. This file does not decide any of that, only who is told once a run reaches a named day count.
